notes: Measured sorbent that satisfies I2 is the N-doped porous carbon scaffold rN-pC (C 91.48 at%, Table S2), Sieverts/PCT H2 isotherms at -196 and -186 C up to 6 MPa (Fig. 2a), with BET SSA 1525.4 m2/g. The 60MgH2@rN-pC composite (60 wt% MgH2) is not itself a carbon sorbent, but its uptake at -196 C is a secondary measurement and does not affect eligibility. TPD and Mg/MgH2 chemisorption data are additional, not the basis for I1. Not retracted (record is_retracted false, no retraction notice in text); experimental article, not a review; no statement that all H2 uptake values were published before. Isotherms are called excess with an absolute-uptake curve derived by a semi-empirical Toth model (Eq. S1).
